title: Grateful Dead Live at Mammoth Gardens on 1970-04-24
lineage: AUD > MR > Reel > DAT > Cool Edit Pro > CDR > SHN

ai_review.summary: A sub‑par, slightly slowed recording marred by tracking glitches, but the Dark Star still shines.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers agree the tape suffers from poor sound quality – it sounds a bit slow, has pitch issues and obvious tracking flaws such as a false start and a broken string.  Despite these technical problems, the performance of Dark Star is praised as a highlight that makes the set worth listening to for dedicated fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviews note serious recording problems but also give moderate praise to Dark Star; overall impression is average, leading to a mid‑range rating with low confidence due to the small sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch appears slightly slower than reference shows, tracking flaws include a false start and broken string, overall sound is muddy but not completely disastrous.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is interrupted by technical glitches and a slower pitch, which affects continuity, though the Dark Star segment remains compelling.
